canonicalStep.title: glovebox-fuse-panel (BMW 328i draft Fuse & Bulb Replacement guide; evidence step 2, 3)

elements.describe: The open glove compartment on the passenger side of the dashboard.
Two round plastic quarter-turn fasteners (fastener type: quarter-turn) that hold the fuse panel cover; turned counterclockwise to unlock.
The removable cover whose back carries the fuse chart sticker.
The junction box fuse panel behind the glove box, reachable once the cover drops.
